title: Finite-ring vector-bundle orientation restricted to the zero section
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $N\geq1$ with $NA=0$, and let $S$ be Noetherian with $N$ invertible on $S$. Work in the ordinary unbounded categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ of constant-$A$ module sheaves, with exact inverse images. For every compactifiable structural map $b$ write $\omega_b=b^\times A$ using the right adjoint of $Rb_!$. Put $A_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}A_T$ and $A_T(d)=A_T(1)^{\otimes d}$, with $A_T(0)=A_T$.
Let $\pi:E\to S$ be a vector bundle of constant rank $d\geq0$, with zero section $z$. Assume $\pi$ is compactifiable. For every affine trivializing open $T\subseteq S$ and linear frame $\phi:E_T\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf A^d_T$ over $T$, let
$$o_\phi:z_T^*\omega_{\pi_T}\xrightarrow{\sim}A_T(d)[2d]$$
be the section restriction of the inverse of the adjoint $\alpha_{p_d}:A_{\mathbf A^d_T}(d)[2d]\to\omega_{p_d}$ of the Kummer-normalized coordinate-tower counit, transported through $\phi$ by the counit-preserving comparison of compact-support right adjoints. For every overlap and every invertible linear change of frames these $o_\phi$ agree under the canonical restriction maps. They glue to a unique isomorphism
$$o_E:z^*\omega_\pi\xrightarrow{\sim}A_S(d)[2d]$$
with these frame restrictions. It is preserved by every $S$-linear bundle isomorphism, using the counit-preserving comparison on the source. For $d=0$, $o_E$ is the identity under $E\cong S$. Empty bases and $A=0$ are allowed.
If $A=\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^n$, $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $n\geq1$, and $\ell$ is invertible on $S$, let $\gamma_{\pi,A_S}:A_E(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{\sim}\pi^\times A_S$ be the purity map adjoint to vector-bundle integration and the canonical projection formula. Then
$$o_E=z^*(\gamma_{\pi,A_S}^{-1})$$
under the canonical ordinary-etale Tate coefficient identifications.
The scheme, morphism, algebra and coefficient notation and the specified comparison maps are those of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-amb-etale-compact-support], [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section], [def-asd-compactifiable], [def-sbc-affine-space], [lem-amb-affine-space-top-trace], [thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity], [def-amb-vector-integration].
